trials.output_a: Rain pattered down. Mara trudged along. The street was as empty as a desert on a Sunday. She approached the door and gave it a good once-over. It looked positively stubborn. She rapped twice, just to be sure. Still, no one answered.
trials.output_b: The rain came down in long silver threads, and Mara sauntered through it, as if the storm were just hanging around, waiting for her invitation. When she finally got to the door and found it locked, she knocked—twice, softly, like a polite question she already knew might not get an answer.
